Name: Survivalcraft Ruins 生存战争·遗迹
Description: Adds explorable surface structures to world generation: fishing huts, hunter camps, wishing wells, ruined homesteads, werewolf dens, shipwrecks, abandoned mines and lighthouses, each with multi-chest weighted loot and one-shot beast ambushes. 为世界生成添加可探索的地表结构:渔屋、猎人营地、许愿井、草原废屋、狼人巢穴、搁浅沉船、废弃矿井、灯塔,均带多箱加权战利品与一次性野兽埋伏。
Author: SCRuins
